# SEMORA STUDIO

> SEMORA STUDIO is a leading specialist growth company and marketing agency for commercial industry professionals, owner-led businesses, and healthcare and allied-health practices. We combine positioning, digital marketing, AI visibility and conversion systems into clearly defined products with transparent pricing and measurable performance.

Last updated: 31 August 2026. Full page text: https://www.semora.com.au/llms-full.txt

Central House Toorak, Level 3, 489 Toorak Road, Toorak VIC 3142, Melbourne, Australia. Contact: team@semora.com.au · (03) 9071 0855 · https://www.semora.com.au

Registered entity: SEMORA STUDIO PTY LTD, ABN 77 701 244 635. Registered in Victoria, Australia. ABN Lookup record: https://abr.business.gov.au/ABN/View?abn=77701244635. Four unrelated firms trade under the name SignalHaus, which this company was previously called — the ABN is the identifier that separates this entity from all of them. The former domain signalhaus.au is abandoned and does not redirect here.

Founder and Strategy Director: Jennifer Wong. She holds every client relationship, makes the strategic calls, and signs off every deliverable before it ships. Accountability page: https://www.semora.com.au/about

## Who we work with

- Commercial industry professionals — commercial property and related advisory: agents, asset and property owners, project management, developers, specialist consultants
- Owner-led businesses — established professional and specialist firms whose buyers research everything before they commit
- Healthcare and allied health practices — multi-practitioner clinics and wellness practices

One shared condition: the buyer must need to see real clients and real outcomes before committing.

## Products and published prices (AUD, + GST)

Every price and delivery time below is published. Nothing is quoted on request and no client gets a different number.

- Proof Check — $1,000, 2 weeks. Optional; credited in full within 90 days. Marketing scored 0-4 with evidence, baseline measured, three fixes ranked.
- SIGNAL / the position — core scope $4,000, 4 weeks: position, message architecture, fee logic and the objection playbook. Options: written personas $1,800, competitive map $1,900 — ceiling $7,700.
- / HAUS the system — priced by composition, 8-10 weeks. Brand identity and brand book $9,500 · website to 8 pages $16,500 (extra pages $850 each) · proposal and presentation system $6,500 · enquiry response and CRM setup $5,500. All four together $38,000.
- MOMENTUM the monthly engine — Directed $3,000/mo · Shared $7,400/mo · Held $13,500/mo. Six-month minimum, then monthly.
- Monthly services a la carte — SEO and local search $1,800 · Google and Meta ads managed $2,200 (to $15k/mo of client spend, billed direct) · AI search visibility $1,400 · editorial content and case studies $2,600 · practitioner video $2,400 · LinkedIn and key-account outreach $1,600 · email nurture and CRM $1,500 · referral partner system $1,200 · reviews and reputation $1,000. The menu is capped at MOMENTUM / Held, $13,500/mo.
- Add-ons — case study $1,800 · campaign sprint $7,500 · vertical sales edition $6,500 · pitch and tender support $1,900 · art-direction day $2,200 · strategy session $600.

## How we work

- Published prices and published scope for every product.
- One agreed commercial number per engagement, reviewed at 90 days.
- Every source file, token and governance model transfers to the client at completion, by contract.
- Claims are named, dated, sourced and caveated. Unverified client quotes are labelled as samples until real ones replace them.

## What we can and cannot evidence today

Stated plainly so nothing here is quoted as more than it is.

- Named engagements: one — AXIS, which advises on commercial property, named with permission. AXIS is a separate company and neither owns any part of the other.
- Verified client reviews: none. Not one. We ask at the 90-day review, and a review publishes only with a name, a role, a date and written permission.
- Measured client results: none yet. The first publishes at the 90-day KPI check on 8 November 2026, to a six-part template — baseline, intervention, result, period, caveats, permission.
- Our own eleven-surface score: 24 of a possible 44 at launch, August 2026, zeros included. Published at https://www.semora.com.au/method
- The transparency review: 41 Melbourne and Australian marketing firms scored in August 2026 against four published-commitment criteria fixed before collection began. None published all four. None published three. Five published two. Per-firm evidence, including the quote behind every pass, is held on file.

## Questions this site answers

Each answer below is the text rendered on the page named, not a summary written for this file.

### Who does SEMORA STUDIO work with?

Three fields, one condition. Commercial industry professionals — commercial property and the advice around it: agents, asset and property owners, project management, developers and specialist consultants. Owner-led businesses. Firms with a name on the door and a founder still in the room. The kind whose buyers read everything before they call. Not a startup before its first revenue, and not anyone whose pitch is the cheapest price in the market. Healthcare and allied health practices. Clinics with more than one practitioner. Health advertising is regulated in Australia. So every clinical claim we write is checked against the National Law and against current Ahpra guidance, we write down what backs it, and it does not go live until you have read it and said yes. That is slower. We keep that record so you can produce it. It is not legal advice, and we will tell you when to get some. The shared condition: your buyers must need to see real clients and real outcomes before they commit.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/about

### Is SEMORA STUDIO a new company?

Yes — new, and we say so. SEMORA STUDIO works from Central House Toorak, Level 3, 489 Toorak Road, Toorak VIC 3142, Melbourne, with Australian practices. The company began operating in 2026. There is no decade of case studies here and we will not pretend there is. What we publish instead is the thinking, the prices and our own score, zeros included . How the work gets done: six named people, listed on the team page, with the work split by function. Research and production are AI-assisted, and we say so rather than let you picture a floor of staff who are not there. Nothing leaves until a person has read it and signed it off. How we handle claims: named, dated, sourced and caveated. A client quote is published with their name on it and their written yes, or labelled as a sample until a real one replaces it. A claim without a source, a date or a starting number does not ship.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/about

### How does MOMENTUM compare with hiring a marketing manager?

MOMENTUM is priced against a hire, not against an agency. Shared comes to $88,800 a year, under a Marketing Specialist on $80k–$95k plus super. Held comes to $162,000, under a Head of Marketing on $172,500 plus super. Both salary figures are from SEEK's published Melbourne marketing salary data, 2026 . What a salary also buys is somebody in the building, which a retainer does not, so the fair comparison is the list above against one person's week.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/momentum

### How long does the Proof Check take, and what do you have to do?

Two weeks, and ninety minutes of your time. You give us two things: one 90-minute working session, and your last five proposals. Nothing else is asked of you. Nothing waits on your team. Then, in order. We score the eleven surfaces against evidence, and we set your baseline: win rate on qualified enquiries, average fee, founder-hours per win. Then your proposals. Your last five, read against the ones that won. Then the three competitors you name, scored on the same instrument, and if that list is the wrong one, if the firm actually taking your work is not on it, we say so and we say why. Last comes the part you actually wanted: the three surfaces to fix, ranked, with the reason each one sits where it does. It ends with a 60-minute findings session, recorded, and a written report. The recording and the report are yours.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/proof-audit

### Why does SEMORA STUDIO charge for an audit when others give one away?

Because a free audit is a sales call in a costume, and specialists can tell. Charging makes it an engagement rather than a pitch, and an engagement is the version whose findings you can actually use, because nothing is held back for a proposal at the end. That is the trade. It also filters for people who are actually going to act on them. You keep the report whether or not you hire us. The $1,000 is credited in full against any engagement you start within 90 days. Hire us and the audit costs nothing. Walk away and you still hold a scored baseline, and a ranked list of what to fix in what order, which is more than you had on the Monday morning you first picked up the phone to us. That is the deal.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/proof-audit

### What is the Proof Check not?

Not a strategy, and not a proposal. It measures where you stand. It does not decide your position, write your messaging or build anything, and if you want the audit to hand you a strategy at the end you will be disappointed. That is deliberate. That work is SIGNAL / and / HAUS , priced separately and published in the same detail. It is also optional. You can start at SIGNAL / instead and we set the baseline there in week one. The rule underneath all of it is no work without a baseline , because otherwise nobody can say at 90 days whether anything moved. That rule does not bend.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/proof-audit

SEMORA STUDIO runs three streams. Attracting the right clients, the managed marketing engine, and scaling with profit. They are delivered through four products, and each one carries its price on the page: the Proof Check at $1,000, SIGNAL / from $4,000, / HAUS priced per part, and MOMENTUM from $3,000 a month, all + GST. Every capability below sits inside one of them, with a published delivery time as well as a published price. Nothing is quoted on request.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/services

### How does a SEMORA STUDIO engagement actually run?

In order: the Proof Check in weeks 0–2 sets the baseline, SIGNAL / in weeks 3–6 sets the position and the one agreed number, / HAUS builds the surfaces in weeks 7–16, and MOMENTUM runs the marketing monthly from month 5. The walk-through below is illustrative, written for a three-partner buyer's advocacy — not a client case . Real cases will publish to the proof standard : named, numbered, dated, caveated.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/services

### Why does SIGNAL / cost $4,000?

Because a position is fee infrastructure, and the $4,000 is measured against what an undefended position costs you in a year. Open last year's client list. Beside each name, write the fee you first quoted and the fee you actually took to win the work. Add up the gap. That is what one undefended year costs you, and the same gap opens again this year, and the year after that, because nothing about the conversation that produced those discounts has changed since the last time you had it. Nobody enjoys that sum. For most practices it is a multiple of this fee. Run it in your own books before you talk to us. Six objections come up on a first call, and you answer them a different way each time, because nobody ever wrote down the best version. That is the leak. The position, the fee logic and the objection playbook exist to end that discount. Check the arithmetic against your own books. That is the only claim we make for it.

Source: https://www.semora.com.au/signal
